none: PAS LON-3577B5: A Roman copper alloy barbarous radiate coin forgery, dating from AD275-285

A Roman copper alloy barbarous radiate coin forgery, dating from AD275-285 (Reece Period 14). The reverse appears to depict a standing figure, possibly a soldier, with a short skirt. All that is visible of the inscription is AVG. This coin is possibly attempting to copy the VIRTVS AVG type. Dimensions: diameter: 11.73 mm; weight: 0.70g
